title: Batched Pandora's Box: one adaptive run (k=2, T=1/5)

ops.note: Classic Pandora's box: open one at a time, keep the best reward seen, pay each box's cost. Here boxes open in batches of up to k=2, plus a fixed setup cost T=1/5 per batch.

ops.caption: Box 2 opens at the same instant: shows 1/2 (not the jackpot 99, not 0)
Cost so far: setup 1/5 + box1 1/5 + box2 1/5 = 3/5

ops.note: Box 2 showed 1/2, not 99 — check whether a second batch is worth it: E[gain from box 3] = 1/5·(10 − 1/2) = 1.9, batch-2 cost = 1 + 1/5 = 1.2. 1.9 > 1.2, so open it.
